images.translated_text: After PostgreSQL, DuckDB is the DBMS I’m most optimistic about—the rising star of analytics. Just as it did with last year’s race to build vector extensions, the PostgreSQL ecosystem has taken an early lead in the race to integrate DuckDB. Even the DuckDB team has joined in. See: “Whoever Integrates DuckDB Best Wins the OLAP Database World.”

images.translated_text: PGConf.dev 2024 had a fascinating talk by CMU’s @abigale_kim, surveying database extensibility and compatibility between PostgreSQL extensions. Unsurprisingly, PostgreSQL leads the field in extensibility, followed by DuckDB. These are also the two DBMSs I’m most optimistic about.
